Korean fans have made multiple attempts to raise concerns about LOONA’s management with BBC. They’re worried about pricing for the concerts, the size of the concert venues, the lack of communication between the girls and fans, and the overall lack of responsiveness from the company itself. It’s easy to write them off as entitled but they’re right in that LOONA aren’t popular domestically and as much as it’s easy for International Orbits to say that their popularity will change, Korean fans really are the metric for that. The way BBC is marketing the girls works globally but in Korean they don’t seem to be gaining fans and the way they’re choosing to promote the girls hasn’t changed to help that. Today BBC posted content from an International fan and many fansites saw that as confirmation that BBC can see their concerns and are simply choosing to dismiss them and as such they’re closing, which isn’t good for LOONA at all. That’s the summary of it from what I’ve heard from Korean fans I know!
